lines.speaker: Micah
lines.text: You keep scanning the Grove like the enemy might be hiding in every leaf.

lines.speaker: Micah
lines.text: I know. I was taught the same lie — that love means vigilance without end.

lines.speaker: Elior
lines.text: If I stop watching, what if harm comes through my silence?

lines.speaker: Micah
lines.text: The Father is not careless. He sees in the dark where we cannot.

lines.speaker: Micah
lines.text: I am learning that witness is not the same as clutching control. I can watch without owning every outcome.

lines.speaker: Micah
lines.text: It already has. You are not alone on the watch tonight.
